answer: Plume–Violet–Marble tariff: identity creation is permissionless, but each new agent receives a violet marble nonce over a plume-walk sample of its funder/action graph. The issuance fee follows C(k)=c0·k^γ (γ>1) for correlated clusters, with rebates only after independent utility. A Sybil farm of k correlated agents pays superlinear issuance plus wallet-separation and coordination costs; honest singletons pay near c0.
